Hadapsar-Manjari kshetriy karyalayantargat palakhi margavaril madat kendra, palakhi visava va mandav vyavstha karane va tadnushangik kame karane.
Prabhag kr. 26 mahmadwadi kusarbag tarawde vasti s.no. 93 mahmadwadi yethil dada gujar shale shejaril kai. Dattoba urfa aappa shankarrav Pazar talav yethe sant srusti ubahrne. (navin pr. Kr. 41)
